description: Production cache rules for hubsofcraftss.com (Cloudflare in front of Vercel).

rules.description: Hub of craftss: bypass cache for admin, cart, checkout, and payment APIs
rules.expression: (http.request.method eq "GET" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cart") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/orders") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/create-checkout") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/cashfree") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/phonepe") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/webhooks") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/cron"))) or (http.request.method ne "GET")

rules.description: Hub of craftss: bypass cache for deep health checks
Hub of craftss: cache Next.js static assets at edge (1 year)
Hub of craftss: cache public brand images and favicons
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/favicon.ico" or http.request.uri.path eq "/site.webmanifest" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/apple-touch-icon") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/android-chrome-") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/og-image.") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/logo."))

rules.description: Hub of craftss: cache public product list API (respect origin s-maxage=300)
